title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a proposed lease with Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Mexico, USA (UNAM USA), for the second…
text:
[Council File 26-1453; CD 14]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a proposed lease with Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Mexico, USA (UNAM USA), for the second floor of the Sepulveda House located at 12 Olvera Street.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. FIND, pursuant to Los Angeles City Charter Section 371 (e)(10) and Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 10.15(a)(10), that the use of competitive bidding for the proposed lease agreement with UNAM USA would be undesirable and impractical. UNAM USA brings a specialized educational mission, academic resources, and a direct cultural connection to El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument’s (El Pueblo) heritage. It proposes to fund the complex historic rehabilitation and reuse of the long-vacant second floor of the Sepulveda House without an immediate capital outlay by the El Pueblo Department. UNAM USA has also committed to provide at least 15 free public educational and cultural events each year and free community use of the renovated conference room and library, subject to availability and prior coordination. A Request for Proposals for a tenant would not advance the City’s purpose of securing this combination of UNAM USA’s educational programming, investment in the historic space, and ongoing public benefits.
2. APPROVE the slightly revised proposed key terms for a lease between the City of Los Angeles and UNAM USA for the second floor of the Sepulveda House, as approved by the Board of El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument Authority Commissioners (Commission) on September 24, 2026, and set forth in the Commission report included in the El Pueblo Department report dated October 9, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Slight revision on key terms: Under the "Base Rent" section of the term sheet, replaced:
"$4,675.50 per month (based on January 2026 market value assessment), increased by Consumer Price Index (CPI) each year."
with: "$4,675.50 per month (based on January 2026 market value assessment), starting upon Substantial Completion of the proposed rehabilitation, increased by CPI each year."
3. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, El Pueblo Department, with the assistance of the City Attorney, to finalize and execute a lease substantially consistent with the approved key terms, subject to approval as to form and legality by the City Attorney and compliance with applicable City requirements.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The El Pueblo Department reports that UNAM USA would pay for the rehabilitation of the leased space. As the project developed, its architect revisited the early construction estimate. The newer review accounts for electrical, lighting, and air- conditioning work that may cost more than first expected, as well as internet, audio- visual, and security systems that were missing from the earlier estimate. It places the preliminary cost between $736,290 and $1,429,320. These figures are for planning. The final cost will become clearer when the plans are complete and contractors price the work. The review also identifies costs that are not included in this range. Under the proposed key terms, the value of approved rehabilitation work would be credited against rent, subject to a minimum rent of $1 per month. UNAM USA would remain responsible for the utilities, maintenance, and other costs assigned under the lease. The El Pueblo Department does not anticipate an immediate capital outlay for the rehabilitation.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A proposed lease of the second floor of the Sepulveda House at 12 Olvera Street in El Pueblo to the Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Mexico, USA.
